title: Turn
description: The leaf of the envelope hierarchy. One model-provider exchange. Persists the full packet plus provider-returned usage and the turn-level status.

sequence.description: 1-based within the loop; resets at each new loop.

usage.description: Provider-returned token counts and computed cost.

cost_pico.description: Per-turn cost in pico-units of the active provider's currency.

finish_reason.description: Provider-reported completion-state token (`stop` | `length` | `tool_calls` | `content_filter` | provider-specific). Null when not reported. Distinct from `status` (HTTP-aligned turn outcome); `finish_reason` describes how the model stopped, `status` describes how the turn resolved.

model.description: Wire-reported model identifier. May differ from `agent.provider.model` for routing-relay providers (OpenRouter, etc.); the verification surface for served-vs-requested alignment.
